posts.name: Wanaka Studio
posts.tagline: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine
posts.description: The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

posts.name: Floot Payments
posts.tagline: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude
posts.description: Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for "a $9/month plan", "a checkout for this course" or "shipping labels for my orders", and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish.

posts.name: Prelulu
posts.tagline: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story
posts.description: Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability.

posts.name: OpenMail
posts.tagline: Give your AI agents an identity through email
posts.description: Your agents sign up for tools, receive verification codes and reply to customers, mostly from your Gmail or a shared sending pool where one bad actor gets everyone flagged. OpenMail gives every AI agent its own inbox on your domain with its own sending reputation, for one API call each. Incoming mail reaches your code over webhook or WebSocket, attachments arrive as text, and there's a hosted MCP server and a Hermes plugin. Built and hosted in the EU, free for 3 inboxes.

posts.name: Render Sandboxes
posts.tagline: A computer for every agent
posts.description: Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app.

posts.name: Orphex MCP
posts.tagline: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP
posts.description: Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 65+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context. Move your AI beyond QA: empower it to analyze integrated performance and take every action a human marketer can. Reallocate budgets, pause unprofitable creatives, or adjust products from a single prompt. Every change is logged and protected by safety guardrails. Start free, 30% off the first month.

posts.name: OpusClip 4.0
posts.tagline: Turn raw footage into ready-to-publish videos with AI
posts.description: OpusClip 4.0 goes beyond AI clipping to edit raw footage into finished videos. Automatically clean up speech, add captions and B-roll, create multiple formats, apply saved editing styles, and generate animated hooks and motion graphics.

posts.name: fileForensics
posts.tagline: Real or not? Check files before your AI trusts them.
posts.description: fileForensics is a trust check for every file your app or agent acts on. Extraction tells you what a document says; fileForensics tells you whether to believe it. It looks for signs of editing, AI-generated content, tampering and details that don’t add up, then returns findings with the evidence: what, where and why. No black-box score. All delivered in one call and works via API, MCP (Claude, Cursor, Codex), the developer portal and the fileAI platform. Check the file before you trust the data.

posts.name: Mellow Kids
posts.tagline: Personalized sleep and development app for parents
posts.description: Most baby apps track what happened. Mellow Kids explains why, and what comes next. 🌙 Understand today: Log sleep, feeds and diapers easily. Mellow spots changes and tells you why. A routine to adjust, or a phase that will pass. 🔮 Prepare for tomorrow: A heads-up before sleep and development change, so you feel ready for each new stage. 🌱 The right guidance at the right time: Evidence based support, from short naps to separation anxiety and first tantrums.

posts.name: Dessn
posts.tagline: The design canvas that runs your real code.
posts.description: When product teams ship fast with AI, it's hard to keep track of what's live and keep it consistent. Dessn runs your codebase on a design canvas, always in sync with prod, so your team and agents work from one shared source of truth. • Audit your product and find inconsistencies • Map user flows with states and personas • Comment, branch and iterate together • Share prototypes for reviews, user tests or sales demos. Connect GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket in one click. Works with every tech stack.

posts.name: KREV AI
posts.tagline: An AI team that runs your ecommerce brand
posts.description: KREV 2.0 is an AI team for your ecommerce brand. Scout tracks 10M+ competitor ads, Luna makes content that looks real, Kai buys your media, Chloe posts what's trending, Rue sends your emails, Toshi edits your store and Max gets you found.

posts.name: Basedash Verified dashboards
posts.tagline: Show your team which dashboards to trust
posts.description: Basedash admins can now mark a dashboard as verified, the same way they verify models. Open the dashboard's more menu, pick Verify dashboard, and a green Verified chip appears next to its name for everyone who opens it. Hover it to see who verified it and when. Only admins can verify, edits keep the verification, a duplicate starts unverified, and every change lands in the audit log. Stop guessing which numbers are right. Show your team which dashboards to trust.

posts.name: Zero Wire
posts.tagline: Check your exposure to critical CVEs with one agent prompt
posts.description: Zero Wire is a free vulnerability intelligence feed from Cloudflare Radar for security leads and engineers. Unlike CVE databases that list everything, it picks the critical issues in Internet-facing software and explains each in plain language: what's affected, who should check, and what to do now, with links to CVE records, vendor advisories and CISA KEV. Each briefing includes a ready prompt for your AI agent to run a read-only exposure check. No account needed.

posts.name: Deployed Yet?
posts.tagline: See if your Vercel, Cloudflare and GitHub deploys shipped
posts.description: A free, open-source Mac menu bar app that answers one question: did it ship? Add as many Vercel, Cloudflare (Workers and Pages) and GitHub Actions accounts as you have, pick the projects to watch, and the menu bar shows ? while building, ✓ when it's live and ! when it broke. Get notified when a deploy fails or production goes live. Tokens stay in your Keychain and are only sent to the provider APIs.

posts.name: TellPip
posts.tagline: A little bird that whispers what to say in your calls
posts.description: TellPip listens to your calls from your Mac (no bot joins), transcribes on-device, remembers what you promised each client and whispers the answer from your own documents when you're asked. Invisible in screen sharing. Built in Europe, with GDPR in mind.

posts.name: Hira
posts.tagline: Your free personal agent for job search
posts.description: Applying to jobs is tedious and time-consuming. Stop applying manually and let Hira, your personalized AI agent, do everything for you. You can text it, connect it to Muse, or go through our website. All for free.

posts.name: CardPointers 8
posts.tagline: Earn more rewards from your credit cards every day

Available as a free download with a premium CardPointers+ tier help users save even more, CardPointers 8 is the biggest update yet, incorporating many new iOS 27 technologies.

posts.name: LiveReacting for ChatGPT

Stream to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, LinkedIn, X or custom RTMP at once, change the playlist while live, and check status and viewers. We run the stream, so your computer can be off. Every paid plan includes the plugin.

posts.description: Drop files easily over your local Wi-Fi: iPhone, iPad, Android, Mac, Windows, Linux, and Android TV. No cloud, no cables, no account — devices talk directly, end-to-end encrypted. Send photos, 4K videos, or whole folders in three taps at full local speed. Stream native-quality video to a D-pad Android TV app, or share a folder once and pull files from any device. Files never leave your network. P2P file transfer is free. Sendu Pro unlocks TV streaming and live shared folders.

posts.name: TrackEdge

Double-tap either top corner to mute, open an app or website, press a keyboard shortcut, or run a Shortcuts action.

posts.name: Hindsight Models and Inference API

No permissions, no account, nothing leaves your Mac.

Whether you're building software, running servers, or customizing your desktop, Fedora 45 gives you a modern Linux foundation.

posts.name: Eyecon
posts.tagline: Auto pause video when you look away

The video keeps playing, you miss a few minutes, and then you drag the progress bar around hunting for the spot where you left off. Eyecon removes that whole loop. The front camera checks one thing: whether your eyes are on the screen. When they are not, Eyecon sends a pause to whatever app is playing.

posts.name: Chorus Weather
posts.tagline: Know when to trust the weather forecast

Chorus compares ECMWF, the US GFS, Germany’s ICON and the UK Met Office and sums them up in one word: Agree, Mixed or Split, with a plain-English reason. Widgets show the verdict at a glance. posts.description: Cosmic Horizon is a 3D universe explorer for iPhone and iPad. Fly from the Solar System through the Milky Way and the Laniakea Supercluster to the observable universe, built on real catalogs of about 500,000 stars and more than 400,000 galaxies.

posts.name: FLUX 3 Image
posts.tagline: Generate and edit images with precise layout control
posts.description: FLUX 3 Image is Black Forest Labs’ image generation and editing model with precise layout control. Place elements in bounding boxes, combine up to 10 reference images, edit specific regions without changing the rest, and generate at native 2K or 4K. It also supports text-to-image and agent-planned layouts. Try it in Playground or via the BFL API.

posts.name: MoleUI
posts.tagline: The SaaS design system for Paper, site and app included
posts.description: MoleUI is a SaaS design system built natively in Paper. Marketing sections, full pages, product blocks and app screens share one set of Tailwind v4 tokens, so your site and app look like one product. Desktop and mobile, new sections every month.

posts.name: uwu.money
posts.tagline: Track spending in seconds. No bank login needed.
posts.description: uwu.money is a free, private expense tracker (Spanish for now, English soon). Log a purchase in seconds from your phone, keep separate spaces for home, business or trips, see where your money went each month and export it all. No bank login.

posts.name: Bleepster
posts.tagline: AI that bleeps profanity on YouTube
posts.description: Bleepster mutes swear words in YouTube videos while the video keeps playing. It reads YouTube's own captions, and an AI checks them in context, so it catches slang, disguised spellings and mixed languages that a word list would miss. Only the word goes silent, or you can pick a classic bleep. A 4-digit Parent PIN locks the settings, and the audio never leaves your browser tab. Works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on Mac. The first 10 videos are free.

posts.name: 3B Infrastructure
posts.tagline: Hand-drawn notes on system design, with demos you can run
posts.description: 3B Infrastructure is a notebook of plain-English explanations and hand-drawn diagrams on how software is built. Sections cover system architecture (26 topics), database concepts (9), AWS scaling (13), DevOps (19) and a 15-step VPS deploy guide, plus engineering subjects and a hand-picked course path. The maker says topics come with demos you can play and step through. The site says it is free to read with nothing to sign up for.

posts.tagline: Launch once. Stay discoverable.
posts.description: Oribisoft is a free product launch and discovery platform built for indie hackers, SaaS founders, and makers who want more than a one day launch. Submit your product, create a permanent product page, showcase what you're building, collect community votes, and compete in weekly rankings. With search friendly listings, maker profiles, and opportunities for discovery through Google and AI search, Oribisoft helps your product stay visible beyond launch day.

posts.name: Burnrate for Jira
posts.tagline: Turn Jira worklogs into project cost and budgets
posts.description: Jira shows who logged time, not what it cost. Burnrate prices every worklog from a rate card and tracks budgets with pace, run-out date and forecast. Reports by project, epic or person, CSV export, built on Atlassian Forge.

posts.name: Competition and Consumer Checker
posts.tagline: A free section-by-section reference to the unfair trading
posts.description: A free section-by-section reference to the unfair trading practices Act, a scope check, and a paid kit with the register, evidence and dated plan.

posts.name: Ownit
posts.tagline: Make Better Engineers!
posts.description: Ownit asks one to three questions about the code you just pushed, right in your terminal.

posts.name: Free Dynamic QR Generator
posts.tagline: 5 free dynamic QR codes with unlimited scans, forever
posts.description: Free Dynamic QR Generator gives you real dynamic QR codes without a trial or credit card. Create up to 5 codes free, forever, with unlimited scans. Change where a code points after it's printed, so a typo or new link never means reprinting. See when and where people scan in real time, add your logo and brand colours, and download high-resolution files for print. Manage everything from one simple dashboard.

posts.name: What runs on my GPU
posts.tagline: Pick your GPU, see which open AI models fit on it
posts.description: Start from the hardware you have, not the model you want. See which popular and trending open models fit on your GPUs, with the memory math behind every verdict. Free, no sign-in, in five languages. For teams that keep AI on their own hardware.

posts.name: Aircal
posts.tagline: Free booking links that show people your best times first
posts.description: Most booking links list every open slot, soonest first, so meetings land wherever someone clicked. With Aircal you describe the meeting in a sentence ("30-minute intro calls, right before or after another meeting") and the people booking you see your best times first. Every other time stays one click away. Works with Google Calendar and Meet, bookers need no account, and it's free with unlimited links.

posts.name: GMaps SMBs Scraper & Lead Harvester!
posts.tagline: Turn local business listings into a ready organized pipeline
posts.description: Discover local businesses, check contact details and website presence, and route relevant prospects into your CRM. GMaps Lead Intake helps agencies and sales teams spend less time assembling lists and more time reviewing the right opportunities.

posts.name: OptiClear
posts.tagline: Free up Mac storage without giving an app root access
posts.description: OptiClear finds developer caches (Xcode, Docker, npm and more), duplicate files, similar photos and leftovers from removed apps. It runs in Apple's App Sandbox, never asks for root, and sends files to the Trash first. Scanning is free.

posts.name: SurrealDB
posts.tagline: SurrealDB 4: the database and memory for every agent
posts.description: SurrealDB is a database for every agent. It starts on its first query, scales to zero when idle, speaks Postgres and MySQL, and remembers in one query.

posts.name: Cozy Winter
posts.tagline: Quiet scenes, cozy companions
posts.description: Snow falling outside. Soft piano in the room. A little companion settling down beside you. Cozy Winter - Relaxing Piano turns your Apple TV into a peaceful winter escape. Explore three animated minimalist scenes, enjoy 19 piano tracks, and let the controls fade away while you read, relax, or spend a quiet evening together. THREE LITTLE WINTER WORLDS • Fireplace — A warm indoor retreat with a tiny black cat that wanders, rests by the window, and naps near the fire.

posts.name: F1 StratSim
posts.tagline: Think like an F1 strategist, one call at a time
posts.description: F1 StratSim is a race strategy game in your browser. Read the telemetry, manage tyres and make pit calls across F1 scenarios. See how your decisions play out and learn why they worked or failed. Think you'd make the better call? Take the pit wall.

posts.name: aireel.tv
posts.tagline: Paste your landing page. Get a fully produced promo film
posts.description: Paste your landing page. Get a fully produced promo film — script, motion design, voiceover, score — in one click.

posts.name: Hero Studio
posts.tagline: The design studio for extraordinary design
posts.description: Hero is the most powerful way to present your screen designs, device mockups and renders—directly in your browser. Hero is not for everyone. If you want every single device ever built you go somewhere else. If you want your digital work to look 🔥🔥🔥 you use Hero. Simple. For the 1% designers who know what it takes to deliver goated portfolios, case studies and award submissions, Hero gives you studio level control to art direct your shots.

posts.name: Schoolable
posts.tagline: Turn a photo into a colourful timetable
posts.description: For families turning school timetable photos or screenshots into colourful plans. Sign in, import a photo, then review and correct the detected subjects, colours, icons and notes. Keep versions for each child and open a print view in A4, A5, A6, pocket or custom sizes. English and German interfaces. Check the AI reading before relying on the timetable.

posts.name: InventarQR
posts.tagline: Plug&Play Warehouse Management System
posts.description: Tired of renting software and buying $2k PDA guns? InventarQR is a plug and play WMS that turns any smartphone into an industrial scanner. Why we’re different: • Lifetime License: One-time fee, never expires. Reseller-friendly. • 100% Offline Mode: Pick and scan seamlessly in dead zones. • GS1-128 Ready: Extract lot, quantity and expiry date in a single tap. • Live Sync: Native Shopify and WooCommerce integration. • Smart Routing: Create paths for pickers and start shipping.
